value.signature: fn is_prefix_of (& self , other : & NamespaceLabel) -> bool

review.body: { let mut theirs = other . atoms () ; let mut ours = self . atoms () ; ours . all (| atom | theirs . next () == Some (atom)) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for label::NamespaceLabel::is_prefix_of.
